import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  n ≤ 100_000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
theorem le_self_mul_self (i : Nat) (hi : 0 < i) : i ≤ i * i := by
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul hi (Nat.le_refl i)
  simpa using this

/-- Inner loop of the sieve: mark `j, j + p, j + 2p, ...` as composite. -/
def markFrom (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) (arr : Array Bool) (j : Nat) : Array Bool :=
  if h : j < arr.size then
    markFrom p hp (arr.set j false h) (j + p)
  else
    arr
termination_by arr.size - j
decreasing_by
  simp only [Array.size_set]
  omega

/-- Outer loop of the sieve: for each `i` with `i * i < n` that is still marked
    prime, mark all multiples of `i` starting at `i * i`. -/
def sieveLoop (n : Nat) (arr : Array Bool) (i : Nat) : Array Bool :=
  if h : 0 < i ∧ i * i < n then
    sieveLoop n (if arr.getD i false then markFrom i h.1 arr (i * i) else arr) (i + 1)
  else
    arr
termination_by n - i
decreasing_by
  have h2 : i < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_self_mul_self i h.1) h.2
  omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def sieve_of_eratosthenes (n : Nat) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) : Array Bool :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  sieveLoop n (Array.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => decide (2 ≤ j.val))) 2
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond (n : Nat) (result : Array Bool) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.size = n ∧
  ∀ i : Nat, i < n →
    ((result.getD i false = true) ↔
      (i > 1 ∧ ∀ d : Nat, (1 < d ∧ d < i) → i % d ≠ 0))
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
theorem sieve_getD_eq (arr : Array Bool) (k : Nat) (hk : k < arr.size) :
    arr.getD k false = arr[k] := by
  simp [Array.getD, hk]

theorem sieve_getD_oob (arr : Array Bool) (k : Nat) (hk : ¬ k < arr.size) :
    arr.getD k false = false := by
  simp [Array.getD, hk]

theorem markFrom_size (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) (arr : Array Bool) (j : Nat) :
    (markFrom p hp arr j).size = arr.size := by
  induction arr, j using markFrom.induct p hp with
  | case1 arr j h ih => rw [markFrom, dif_pos h, ih]; simp
  | case2 arr j h => rw [markFrom, dif_neg h]

/-- Indices not congruent to `j` modulo `p` (or below `j`) are untouched. -/
theorem markFrom_getD_of_not (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) (arr : Array Bool) (j k : Nat)
    (hk : ¬ (j ≤ k ∧ p ∣ (k - j))) :
    (markFrom p hp arr j).getD k false = arr.getD k false := by
  revert hk
  induction arr, j using markFrom.induct p hp with
  | case1 arr j h ih =>
    intro hk
    rw [markFrom, dif_pos h]
    have h2 : ¬ (j + p ≤ k ∧ p ∣ (k - (j + p))) := by
      rintro ⟨hle, hdvd⟩
      refine hk ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
      have heq : k - j = (k - (j + p)) + p := by omega
      rw [heq]
      exact Nat.dvd_add hdvd dvd_rfl
    rw [ih h2]
    have hne : j ≠ k := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hk ⟨le_refl _, by simp⟩
    by_cases hklt : k < arr.size
    · rw [sieve_getD_eq _ _ (by simpa using hklt), sieve_getD_eq _ _ hklt]
      simp [Array.getElem_set, hne]
    · rw [sieve_getD_oob _ _ (by simpa using hklt), sieve_getD_oob _ _ hklt]
  | case2 arr j h =>
    intro _
    rw [markFrom, dif_neg h]

/-- Every visited index (i.e. every index `≥ j` that is congruent to `j` mod `p`)
    is marked composite. -/
theorem markFrom_getD_marked (p : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) (arr : Array Bool) (j k : Nat)
    (hjk : j ≤ k) (hd : p ∣ (k - j)) (hk : k < arr.size) :
    (markFrom p hp arr j).getD k false = false := by
  revert hjk hd hk
  induction arr, j using markFrom.induct p hp with
  | case1 arr j h ih =>
    intro hjk hd hk
    rw [markFrom, dif_pos h]
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hjk with heq | hlt
    · subst heq
      rw [markFrom_getD_of_not p hp (arr.set j false h) (j + p) j (by rintro ⟨hle, -⟩; omega)]
      rw [sieve_getD_eq _ _ (by simpa using h)]
      simp
    · have hpk : p ≤ k - j := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hd
      have hd2 : p ∣ k - (j + p) := by
        have heq : k - (j + p) = (k - j) - p := by omega
        rw [heq]
        exact Nat.dvd_sub' hd dvd_rfl
      exact ih (by omega) hd2 (by simpa using hk)
  | case2 arr j h =>
    intro hjk _ hk
    omega

/-- The loop invariant predicate: `k` survived all marking rounds `p < i`. -/
def Qsieve (k i : Nat) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ k ∧ ∀ p, 2 ≤ p → p < i → p * p ≤ k → ¬ (p ∣ k)

theorem Qsieve_succ (k i : Nat) (hi2 : 2 ≤ i) :
    Qsieve k (i + 1) ↔ (Qsieve k i ∧ ¬ (i * i ≤ k ∧ i ∣ k)) := by
  unfold Qsieve
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h2, hall⟩
    refine ⟨⟨h2, fun p hp2 hpi hsq => hall p hp2 (by omega) hsq⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨hle, hdvd⟩
    exact hall i hi2 (by omega) hle hdvd
  · rintro ⟨⟨h2, hall⟩, hni⟩
    refine ⟨h2, ?_⟩
    intro p hp2 hpi hsq hdvd
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p i with hlt | hge
    · exact hall p hp2 hlt hsq hdvd
    · have hpe : p = i := by omega
      subst hpe
      exact hni ⟨hsq, hdvd⟩

/-- Correctness of the `i * i` optimization: below `i * i`, surviving all rounds
    `p < i` is the same as being prime. -/
theorem Qsieve_iff_spec (k i : Nat) (hk : k < i * i) :
    Qsieve k i ↔ (1 < k ∧ ∀ d : Nat, (1 < d ∧ d < k) → k % d ≠ 0) := by
  unfold Qsieve
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hk2, hQ⟩
    refine ⟨hk2, ?_⟩
    rintro d ⟨hd1, hd2⟩ hmod
    have hdvd : d ∣ k := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hmod
    have hnp : ¬ Nat.Prime k := by
      intro hp
      rcases (Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd hp d hdvd) with h | h <;> omega
    have hpd : k.minFac ∣ k := Nat.minFac_dvd k
    have hpp : Nat.Prime k.minFac := Nat.minFac_prime (by omega)
    have hp2 : 2 ≤ k.minFac := hpp.two_le
    have hsq : k.minFac * k.minFac ≤ k := by
      have h1 := Nat.minFac_sq_le_self (show 0 < k by omega) hnp
      rw [pow_two] at h1
      exact h1
    have hpi : k.minFac < i := by
      by_contra hc
      push_neg at hc
      have : i * i ≤ k.minFac * k.minFac := Nat.mul_le_mul hc hc
      omega
    exact hQ k.minFac hp2 hpi hsq hpd
  · rintro ⟨hk1, hspec⟩
    refine ⟨hk1, ?_⟩
    intro p hp2 hpi hsq hdvd
    have hplt : p < k := by
      have : p * 2 ≤ p * p := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_refl p) hp2
      omega
    refine hspec p ⟨by omega, hplt⟩ ?_
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hdvd
    exact Nat.mul_mod_right p c

/-- One round of the outer loop preserves the invariant. -/
theorem sieve_step_inv (n i : Nat) (hi : 0 < i) (hi2 : 2 ≤ i) (arr : Array Bool)
    (hsize : arr.size = n)
    (hinv : ∀ k, k < n → (arr.getD k false = true ↔ Qsieve k i)) (hin : i < n)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < n) :
    ((if arr.getD i false then markFrom i hi arr (i * i) else arr).getD k false = true
      ↔ Qsieve k (i + 1)) := by
  split
  · rename_i hb
    by_cases hcase : i * i ≤ k ∧ i ∣ k
    · have hmark : (markFrom i hi arr (i * i)).getD k false = false := by
        refine markFrom_getD_marked i hi arr (i * i) k hcase.1 ?_ (by omega)
        exact Nat.dvd_sub' hcase.2 (dvd_mul_left i i)
      rw [hmark, Qsieve_succ k i hi2]
      constructor
      · intro hc; exact absurd hc (by simp)
      · rintro ⟨-, h2⟩; exact absurd hcase h2
    · have hkeep : (markFrom i hi arr (i * i)).getD k false = arr.getD k false := by
        refine markFrom_getD_of_not i hi arr (i * i) k ?_
        rintro ⟨hle, hdvd⟩
        refine hcase ⟨hle, ?_⟩
        have hd2 := Nat.dvd_add hdvd (dvd_mul_left i i)
        have heq : k - i * i + i * i = k := by omega
        rwa [heq] at hd2
      rw [hkeep, hinv k hk, Qsieve_succ k i hi2]
      tauto
  · rename_i hb
    have hnQ : ¬ Qsieve i i := fun h => hb ((hinv i hin).mpr h)
    rw [hinv k hk, Qsieve_succ k i hi2]
    constructor
    · intro hQ
      refine ⟨hQ, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨hle, hdvd⟩
      unfold Qsieve at hnQ
      push_neg at hnQ
      obtain ⟨p, hp2, hpi, hpsq, hpdvd⟩ := hnQ hi2
      have hii : i ≤ i * i := le_self_mul_self i hi
      exact hQ.2 p hp2 hpi (le_trans hpsq (le_trans hii hle)) (dvd_trans hpdvd hdvd)
    · tauto

theorem sieveLoop_spec (n : Nat) (arr : Array Bool) (i : Nat) :
    2 ≤ i → arr.size = n → (∀ k, k < n → (arr.getD k false = true ↔ Qsieve k i)) →
    (sieveLoop n arr i).size = n ∧
      ∀ k, k < n → ((sieveLoop n arr i).getD k false = true
        ↔ (1 < k ∧ ∀ d : Nat, (1 < d ∧ d < k) → k % d ≠ 0)) := by
  induction arr, i using sieveLoop.induct n with
  | case1 arr i h ih =>
    intro hi2 hsize hinv
    rw [sieveLoop, dif_pos h]
    have hin : i < n := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_self_mul_self i h.1) h.2
    have hsize' : (if arr.getD i false then markFrom i h.1 arr (i * i) else arr).size = n := by
      split
      · rw [markFrom_size]; exact hsize
      · exact hsize
    exact ih (by omega) hsize'
      (fun k hk => sieve_step_inv n i h.1 hi2 arr hsize hinv hin k hk)
  | case2 arr i h =>
    intro hi2 hsize hinv
    rw [sieveLoop, dif_neg h]
    refine ⟨hsize, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    have hni : ¬ (i * i < n) := by
      intro hc
      exact h ⟨by omega, hc⟩
    rw [hinv k hk]
    exact Qsieve_iff_spec k i (by omega)
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond_satisfied (n : Nat) (h_precond : sieve_of_eratosthenes_precond n) :
    sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond n (sieve_of_eratosthenes n h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold sieve_of_eratosthenes_postcond sieve_of_eratosthenes
  refine sieveLoop_spec n (Array.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => decide (2 ≤ j.val))) 2
    (by norm_num) (by simp) ?_
  intro k hk
  have hval : (Array.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => decide (2 ≤ j.val))).getD k false = decide (2 ≤ k) := by
    rw [sieve_getD_eq _ _ (by simpa using hk)]
    simp
  rw [hval]
  simp only [Qsieve, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h2
    exact ⟨h2, fun p hp2 hp2' => absurd hp2' (by omega)⟩
  · intro h
    exact h.1
  -- !benchmark @end proof

`LEAN VERIFIED` — only two deprecation warnings (`Nat.dvd_sub'`) and the unused `h_precond` binders remain, no errors.

**What's in `Solution.lean`:**

*auxcode* — the actual sieve:
- `markFrom p hp arr j`: inner stride loop, sets `j, j+p, j+2p, …` to false; terminates on `arr.size - j` (needs `0 < p`).
- `sieveLoop n arr i`: outer loop, while `i*i < n`, marks from `i*i` with stride `i` only when `arr[i]` is still true, then recurses on `i+1`; terminates on `n - i` via `i ≤ i*i < n`.

*code* — initialize `Array.ofFn` with `0`/`1` false and everything else true, then `sieveLoop n · 2`.

*lemma* — the three verification challenges from the description:
- **Stride**: `markFrom_getD_marked` / `markFrom_getD_of_not` prove that exactly the indices `k ≥ j` with `p ∣ k - j` get marked, by functional induction on `markFrom.induct`.
- **Array invariant**: `Qsieve k i := 2 ≤ k ∧ ∀ p, 2 ≤ p → p < i → p*p ≤ k → ¬ p ∣ k`, preserved by `sieve_step_inv`. Skipping a composite `i` is justified by reusing `i`'s own witness `p` (`p ∣ i ∣ k` and `p*p ≤ i ≤ i*i ≤ k`), so no needed marking is lost.
- **`i*i` optimization**: `Qsieve_iff_spec` — for `k < i*i`, surviving is equivalent to primality, since a composite `k` satisfies `minFac k ^ 2 ≤ k < i*i`, hence `minFac k < i` would already have marked it.

*proof* — instantiates `sieveLoop_spec` at `i = 2`, where the initial array satisfies the invariant vacuously.
